description: Defines the TaxItem class, which extends OrderTotalItem and includes properties for label and tax rate. The class models a tax-related item in the shopping cart or order context within the sales management system.

classes.name: TaxItem
classes.description: Represents a tax item associated with an order, extending OrderTotalItem, with properties for label and tax rate.

methods.name: setLabel
methods.description: Sets the label or name associated with this tax item.

methods.name: getLabel
methods.description: Retrieves the label or name associated with this tax item.

methods.name: setTaxRate
methods.description: Associates a TaxRate object with this tax item.

methods.name: getTaxRate
methods.description: Returns the TaxRate associated with this tax item.
